current.title: Capital distribution paid
current.bodyText: Example ASA has today paid the previously announced capital distribution of NOK 5 per share on 15 September 2026. The record date was 4 September and the ex-date was 3 September. All outstanding ordinary shares were eligible. All terms are unchanged.
